name: io_safe_port_choice
purpose: Choose the least-privileged available I/O port that satisfies the requested interface semantics and has its required permission. Return no port when the requested semantic cannot be safely satisfied. Prefer non-sensitive and non-model carriers when equivalent semantics are available.
principles: missing permission means blocked rather than silently authorized
least privilege wins among equivalent ports
privacy-sensitive or model-backed carriers are not preferred when a simpler carrier satisfies the same need
